main.description: A scope's policy for its packages, at record key 'self'. A release of any package in the scope needs the larger of its maintainers record's 'threshold' and 'minimumThreshold', and of its 'humans' and 'minimumHumans'. The defaults are what a new package's maintainers record starts with. A change counts once the scope maintainers record's 'ownerThreshold' of owners have attested it.

minimumThreshold.description: The fewest maintainers who must attest a release of a package in the scope.

minimumHumans.description: The fewest of a release's attestations that must come from people rather than automation.

defaultTeams.description: The teams a new package is maintained by, beside its creator.

org.description: The organization the team belongs to.
